title: Conceptual Blending in Argumentation: Hidat ver and Zátonyra fut
goal: I can use figurative verbs such as *hidat ver*, *zátonyra fut* and *gúzsba köt*.
I can combine two figurative verbs in one sentence without mixing the images.
I can describe how a plan fails or succeeds with figurative verbs.
